reason: README gives a CLI inference command with bundled prompt wav/npy files, public non-gated HF checkpoints, and CPU inference is supported.
demo: Inference > Command-Line Usage (Standard), English prompt example
goal: Install the project per the README (Python 3.10, requirements.txt, PYTHONPATH set to the repo), download the public pretrained checkpoints from Hugging Face ByteDance/MegaTTS3 into /work/MegaTTS3/checkpoints, then run `python tts/infer_cli.py --input_wav assets/English_prompt.wav --input_text '<some English sentence>' --output_dir ./gen --p_w 2.0 --t_w 3.0` on CPU only.
